comparison.objective: Install two hook-in gondola brackets at a marked equal height and seat a steel shelf on them.
comparison.physical_skill: Hook insertion, downward seating, bilateral height matching, and bimanual shelf placement onto two supports.
comparison.success_condition: Both brackets occupy the marked matching slots and are seated; shelf rests level and securely on both brackets.
comparison.reason: Tests repeated hook latching and supported shelf placement rather than deliberate notch fracture and containment of liberated parts.
